verdict.rationale: SigNoz documents building against standard OpenTelemetry SDKs for traces, logs and gen_ai telemetry (signoz-docs-6, signoz-docs-31, signoz-docs-23), and service accounts provide programmatic API access (signoz-docs-22, signoz-docs-44). However, these SDKs are third-party OTel libraries rather than SigNoz-published SDKs, and no OpenAPI spec was found to generate clients from (signoz-probe-3). Missing for 10: first-party SigNoz client SDKs for its API, a published OpenAPI spec, SDK reference docs, and independent corroboration of SDK-based development.
